top_signals.title: Chinese military commander overseeing Taiwan operations meets U.S. PACOM chief
top_signals.summary: PACOM chief Adm. Sam Paparo recently held his first in-person talks with Gen. Yang Zhibin, commander of the Chinese military's Eastern Theater Command.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: HK’s Lee Says City to Expand Offshore Yuan Usage in 5-Year Plan
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said the city’s first five-year plan will focus on areas including expanding offshore yuan usage and cross-border investment with the mainland.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japan says progress made on $550 billion investment pact with U.S.
top_signals.summary: Trade minister Ryosei Akazawa declined to comment in detail, but said discussions on AI and chips will carry "very significant weight."
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
